title: Concept: go.mod excludes a published module version
description: go.mod declares an `exclude` directive that keeps a specific version out of the build, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The exclusion is invisible to anyone reading the dependency list, and a fix published in that version never reaches the build.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through go.mod (go).
risk: The exclusion is invisible to anyone reading the dependency list, and a fix published in that version never reaches the build.
